predicates.name: audit.applicable
predicates.description: The capability registry contains a record whose scope intersects the work item scope, or the repository has any commit history.

predicates.name: architecture.required
predicates.description: A planned or actual change touches a declared contract boundary — api_map, source_map, a schema or migration path — or would change canonical ownership in domain_model, or an audit finding is categorized structural.

predicates.name: ux.required
predicates.description: context.ui_map is non-empty and a mutation event touches a path under a ui_map surface, or an API whose consumers include a ui_map surface changed shape.

predicates.name: production.applicable
predicates.description: The discovered environments include one classified production and the work item scope reaches it.

predicates.name: reality.implementation_present
predicates.description: A branch or commit within scope implements the work.

predicates.name: reality.tests_present
predicates.description: Tests covering the scope exist and executed.

predicates.name: reality.pr_open
predicates.description: A pull request for this work item's branch exists and is open.

predicates.name: reality.pr_approved
predicates.description: The pull request is approved for its current head.

predicates.name: reality.pr_reviewed
predicates.description: A review has been delivered on the pull request, whatever its verdict. This is PR_REVIEW's satisfied_by, and deliberately not pr_approved: the stage obtains a review, and a review that requested changes has still happened. Keying it on approval would make the stage look un-run in exactly the case its own loop edge to REVIEW_TRIAGE exists for.

predicates.name: reality.pr_has_unresolved_comments
predicates.description: Unresolved review threads exist on the current head.

predicates.name: reality.ci_green
predicates.description: CI passed for the current head SHA, within the freshness window.

predicates.name: reality.stage_completed_previously
predicates.description: A prior Workflow Run against this Work Item completed the stage being asked about, read from current_reality.agentos_history. This is the satisfied_by of the read-only analysis stages, and it is keyed on AgentOS's own ledger because code existing does not mean an analysis happened. The ledger is authoritative about what AgentOS did and says nothing about whether it still holds, which is the right scope: 'did we analyse this' is a question about the past.

predicates.name: reality.children_exist
predicates.description: The work item has at least one child, whatever its state. DECOMPOSITION's satisfied_by, and a different question from children_all_terminal.

predicates.name: reality.children_all_terminal
predicates.description: Every child work item is ACHIEVED, ABANDONED or SUPERSEDED.

predicates.name: reality.outcome_already_satisfied
predicates.description: The desired outcome holds, observably, now.

predicates.name: reality.deployed
predicates.description: The change is present in a named environment.

predicates.name: regression.suspected
predicates.description: reality.outcome_already_satisfied is FALSE and the work item scope intersects a capability record whose status is WORKING or PROVEN. It reads as: something that demonstrably used to work does not now. The one floor rule keyed on reality rather than on type, because a rule keyed on a resolved field can only be as good as the resolution.
